negative_science: Q80 cross-expert shared-basis REFUTED (experts mutually orthogonal, cos 0.004)
Q80 simplistic bandwidth-bound thesis REFUTED (0.79% of ceiling, ~51% GPU idle)
DSV4F route-ID readback serializer hypothesis REFUTED
shader compile as primary wall REFUTED/deprioritized
raw activation cosine is deceptive here: measured null baseline 0.898
fits with rows < fitted dimension are UNDERDETERMINED and their scores meaningless
never calibrate on a degraded baseline or on synthetic/Gaussian activations
immutable-identity recomputation per token has been the real latency three times
DSV4F attention: collapsing 17 dispatches into one serial encoder is bit-identical and reduces encoders 731->43 but does NOT reduce attention GPU time. Encoder gaps are not the attention wall.

DSV4F path_resolve/verify identity tax is NOT on the critical path. Reducing it 2.9x (983->343 ms parallel-sum) produced ZERO whole-token improvement, because a parallel sum across threads is not token latency. Do not attack it again for wall time.

Q80 topology collapse is NOT the lever: overlap, fuse-to-51-CBs and serial-encoder are all bit-identical and all fail to win complete-token wall (fuse REGRESSED 516 vs 307 ms). Matches DSV4F where 731->43 encoders moved attention GPU by nothing. Occupancy, not topology.
Q80 density fits are route-starved: p10=34 rows against 2048 dims, 221 never-routed pairs, and no on-disk post-SwiGLU X for down_proj. Any organ score from the 25k capture is suspect.

Q80 decoded-weight caching is REFUTED by arithmetic: dense restore is 12 MiB/expert = 288 GiB for all (layer,expert) versus 11 GiB packed. Caching decoded W undoes the representation it exists to create.

Q80 down_proj low-rank ALREADY executes L @ (R @ x) - it does not reconstruct W. The representation->algebra optimization was already in place; do not re-open it. The remaining decode cost is occupancy, not algebra.

machine_truth.note: macOS `top` PhysMem 'used' counts inactive/cached pages and is MISLEADING. Verified 2026-08-16: top said 93G used / 2.5G unused while memory_pressure said 90% free, swap 0.19 MB of 1024 MB, pageouts 1709. Real availability = (pages_free + pages_inactive) * 16384 ~= 56 GiB. Use memory_pressure and vm_stat, never top, to decide whether to launch a memory-heavy lane.
